journeyObjective: Guide customer through First Home Savings progress tracking and self-paced financial literacy modules.
entryPoint: User opens the rewards and financial education overview screen.
completionDefinition: Customer reviews goal progress (63%) and accesses the next educational module or quiz at their own pace.

miniJourneys.customerQuestion: Where do I stand right now with my points and savings competence?
miniJourneys.entryCondition: Screen launch with valid session wallet context.

miniJourneys.customerQuestion: How do my rewards translate into real-world value and how do points work?
miniJourneys.entryCondition: User reviews current balance and tangible equivalent.

miniJourneys.customerQuestion: What is my next self-paced educational step and mastery checkpoint?
miniJourneys.entryCondition: User understands value foundation and seeks learning progression.

miniJourneys.customerQuestion: What rewards are linked to my First Home Savings milestones?
miniJourneys.entryCondition: User completes learning check and inspects milestone rewards.

supportingSurfaces.purpose: Provide transparency on reward provenance and educational source integrity.
contentNotes: Source attribution for financial literacy modules
